definitions.explanation: A wind that changes direction with the seasons. In Japan, this refers especially to the cold northwesterly winds from Siberia in winter and the warm southerly winds in summer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{季節風|きせつふう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: The winter seasonal winds are strong.

examples.japanese: {季節風|きせつふう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{日本海側|にほんかいがわ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大雪|おおゆき}→大雪：03017_ooyuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Due to the seasonal winds, the Sea of Japan side gets heavy snowfall.

examples.japanese: ⟦アジア→アジア：01763_ajia⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{季節風|きせつふう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{農業|のうぎょう}→農業：01491_nougyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えて→与える：01821_ataeru⟧おり、{雨季|うき}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{乾季|かんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決定|けってい}→決定：02701_kettei⟧づけて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: In Asia, monsoons have a major impact on agriculture, determining the rainy and dry seasons.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧ (season) + {風|ふう} (wind). Refers to winds that blow from different directions depending on the season, driven by temperature differences between land and ocean.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{季節風|きせつふう}: winter monsoon
- ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{季節風|きせつふう}: summer monsoon
- {季節風|きせつふう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧: influence of seasonal winds
- {季節風|きせつふう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧: seasonal winds blow

JAPAN-SPECIFIC:
In winter, cold {季節風|きせつふう} blow from the northwest (from Siberia), picking up moisture over the Sea of Japan and depositing heavy snow on the {日本海側|にほんかいがわ} (Sea of Japan coast). In summer, warm moist winds blow from the southeast, contributing to the humid climate.

RELATED WORDS:
- モンスーン: monsoon — the English loanword, used interchangeably in some contexts
- {偏西風|へんせいふう}: westerlies — a different wind system (prevailing westerly winds)
- {貿易風|ぼうえきふう}: trade winds
